assessments.reasoning: The pp.89–90 ReDim branch for a matching array variable explicitly leaves only the final upper bound variable with Preserve. The same rule assigns runtime error 9 to rank changes, changes to any lower bound, and changes to any earlier upper bound.

challenge.method: Trace the declaration fallback at p.89 and independently check the list of illegal changes on p.90. Challenge the claim with a missing name, an earlier dimension change, a lower-bound change, a rank change, and the ByRef lock case.
challenge.results: The lower-bound, earlier upper-bound, and rank alternatives explicitly lead to error 9 in the scoped branch. A missing name uses the local declaration fallback and a ByRef lock invokes a different error. Neither case can be used to broaden the claim.

limitations: This judgment applies to the exact May 20, 2025 MS-VBAL revision 2.4. The publisher currently lists a later edition. Its requirements and behavior of any Office host are outside this review.
The finding assumes a valid existing resizable variable and no independent intervening error. It does not make a representation or storage-layout assertion.
